selection_rule: Demand families (scripts/search_intelligence/demand_families.js, recorded per site in data/search_intelligence/<host>/demand_families.json): queries clustered by head term (demand_intents.json) and landing page, state hubs collapsed to one template. A family qualifies if (a) a page in it has >= 2 impressions at average position <= 15, or (b) it is one of the site's top 5 families by 28-day impressions with >= 5 impressions at impression-weighted position <= 95. Its landing page is strengthened when the page's intent matches; otherwise the family records why (intent_mismatch / no_page). This list holds the strengthened GUIDES (their homepage and guides-hub links come from it); state hubs in a strengthened family render the pack page set's search_strengthening.state_hub on every state page with >= 10 family impressions. Until 11 Oct 2026 the rule was (a) alone, which excluded the pages carrying the most impressions (positions 47-92).
what_strengthening_means: title + H1 aligned to the query Google shows for the page (or the page's topic phrase when Search Console anonymises it), a definition paragraph (data-search-definition), an FAQ from the real questions with FAQPage JSON-LD (data-search-faq), and links from the homepage and the guides hub (data-search-ranked-links). Source of each page: its page-set JSON field search_strengthening; rendered by scripts/search_intelligence/render_blocks.js.
